amends.policy: The v2 files remain immutable; this is a separately identified replacement candidate.

scope.universe_warning: fixed surviving cash-only subset; not historical market or App candidates

preconditions: A reviewer other than the proposal author accepts this contract and records the exact proposal hash.
The exact normalized inputs identified by the frozen dataset hash are available to the isolated runner without reading 2024+.
Each implementation change has a new source commit; run 36081668572 and every failed result remain unchanged.
Every registered path is retained, including zero-trade and failed paths; no result-driven omission or replacement is allowed.

metric_contract.completed_trade: a record present in the retained trades array with one entry and one exit

median_net_trade_return.formula: ordinary median of completed-trade net_return; for an even count, arithmetic mean of the two center values

profit_factor.numerator: sum(net_pnl for completed trades where net_pnl > 0)
profit_factor.denominator: abs(sum(net_pnl for completed trades where net_pnl < 0))

largest_winner_share_of_positive_profit.denominator: sum(net_pnl for completed trades where net_pnl > 0)

largest_symbol_share_of_positive_profit.numerator: maximum across symbols of sum(net_pnl for that symbol's completed trades where net_pnl > 0); losing trades are not netted
largest_symbol_share_of_positive_profit.denominator: sum(net_pnl for all completed trades where net_pnl > 0)

terminal_return_ex_unavailable_receivabl.interpretation: terminal accounting decomposition only; not a counterfactual portfolio path

metric_contract.numeric_comparison: IEEE-754 parsed values; gates use the written operators without rounding; displays may round only after decisions

new_fields.raw_confirmation_count: count of signal rows where raw_signal_state == confirmed
new_fields.eligible_order_count: count of signal rows where plan_state == eligible_proxy
new_fields.avoid_chase_count: count of signal rows where plan_state == avoid_chase

canonical_equality.trial_result_files: For every strategy/scenario pair, canonical JSON of the complete existing result object must be exactly equal; recursive object keys are sorted, array order is retained, and numeric values are not rounded.
canonical_equality.signal_rows: For every strategy, canonical JSON of every existing signal row and its original array order must be exactly equal. New counts are emitted only in a separate reporting object, never injected into existing rows.
canonical_equality.forbidden_differences: Any difference in trial result files, existing signal rows, projected ledger fields, eligible signals, fills, completed trades, costs or portfolio metrics invalidates R1.

work_items.decision_rule: All 15 paths and all equality checks must pass. Any mismatch is retained as a failed repair run and cannot replace v1.
Failure of any gate keeps S3 exploratory. Passing all gates would still be a result-informed development diagnostic, not OOS alpha, validation or trading authorization.

work_items.frozen_fields: Every S4 v1 parameter, universe, date, cost and execution rule except atr5_over_atr20_max.
work_items.multiplicity_rule: Report both variants and all scenarios. Do not select, promote or rename a development winner.
work_items.decision_rule: Development output may reject or retain a hypothesis for a later independently defined panel; it cannot produce a deployable strategy.

paths.rule: Recognize the entitlement as a receivable on ex-date and never release it to spendable cash during the study.

On the next recorded market session after ex-date, release the entitlement into spendable cash before pre-open sizing and reservation, so it may fund that session's opening orders. This is an optimistic bound, not a factual payment schedule.

session_event_order_optimistic_path: release eligible next-session receivables to cash
size opening orders and reserve cash
work_items.exclusion_reason: R4 isolates payment availability under baseline; cost/capacity interactions require a separately registered study.
work_items.decision_rule: Show all ten paths. The optimistic path is a sensitivity ceiling and may not be the headline return or promotion evidence.

blocked_robustness.reason: The frozen strategy needs at least five complete momentum members and the eligible subset has exactly five.
blocked_robustness.unblock: Acquire a point-in-time-defined panel with at least ten eligible symbols without using 2024+ holdout data.

blocked_robustness.test: S5 revenue and S7 broker-revision factors
blocked_robustness.reason: No licensed point-in-time event history with publication, revision, correction and entitlement provenance.

global_decision_rules: Weekly 5%, monthly 10% and annualized 50% are not selection criteria.
No development-only result may be called out-of-sample, alpha, validated profitability or deployable.
Do not replace the v1 registry, ledger, zero-trade S4 result or failed trials.
Any implementation defect requires a new commit and run with an explicit invalidation reason; no silent overwrite.
Article publication, merge and deployment remain outside this proposal.

authorization.reason: Independent contract review and exact normalized replay inputs are still required.
